label: Weather forecasting uses the latest ingress plus the latest lunar phase before the target date

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske says forecasts for any date are built from the most recent ingress and lunar phase prior to the forecast date, with ingresses supplying the seasonal framework and lunar phases supplying shorter event triggers.

label: Horizon and meridian line intersections can act as target zones for severe weather

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske says horizon lines often show the path storms and fronts follow and that line intersections are target locations, especially when searching for potential severe weather.

label: Mercury-Uranus hard weather signatures include storms, tornadoes, hail, and hurricanes

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske gives Mercury-Uranus hard and neutral aspects as signatures of sudden changes, storms, hurricanes, tornadoes, and hail.

label: Saturn-Neptune hard signatures support flood and chronic heavy precipitation logic

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske assigns Saturn-Neptune hard and neutral aspects to above-normal precipitation, possible floods and flash floods, chronic heavy rain, excessive snow, and humidity.

label: Bonatti provides a dedicated natural-astrology framework for rains and mutations of the air

source.title: Bonatti on Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Bonatti's weather treatise explicitly covers heavy rains, mutations of the air, showers, heavy rains and winds, the places of rains, and month-level rainy-period judgment.

label: Bonatti preserves explicit prohibition logic for rain

source.title: Bonatti on Mundane Astrology
source.claim: Bonatti includes a dedicated section on when Saturn prohibits rains and how rain testimony can be blocked, moderated, or allowed.

label: Watters supports Uranian signification for violent storms, hurricanes, and tornadoes

source.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source.claim: Watters assigns the circulation of the winds to Uranian logic and explicitly includes violent storms, hurricanes, and tornados.

label: Green and Carter place natural collective phenomena inside mundane astrology

source.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source.claim: Green frames mundane astrology as the study of ingresses, new moons, eclipses, and other celestial phenomena affecting countries, and Carter explicitly includes droughts and other collective natural events in mundane subject matter.

label: Venus on the lower meridian in winter can indicate heavy snow or freezing rain

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske says Venus conjunct the IC can indicate precipitation to the north and, especially in winter months, can indicate heavy snow or freezing rain.

label: Mars is nearly always active during intense heat waves and drought

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske says rising temperatures and evaporation are characteristic of Mars and that Mars is nearly always active during intense heat waves and drought, especially when in Leo.

label: Uranus is a cold-wave and unseasonably cold indicator in cold months

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske says Uranus is always indicative of colder temperatures and cold waves in cold months, and that Uranus conjunct the IC in an ingress or lunar phase chart indicates unseasonably cold temperatures.

label: Mercury is a primary wind and front indicator in weather charts

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske says Mercury is primarily concerned with wind direction and velocity, is often active where fronts occur, and when conjunct the IC in an ingress or lunar phase chart indicates unseasonably cool weather and strong winds of varying frequency.

label: Ingress charts establish seasonal temperature and precipitation baselines

source.title: Predicting Weather Events with Astrology
source.claim: Riske says the solar ingress indicates seasonal trends, each ingress is valid for roughly three months, and temperatures can be judged as above or below normal for the area over the season rather than as a single event-day condition.
